name: coordraw-tooling
description: Tooling for Eraser Diagrams CLI dependency

scripts.compile:demo: dotnet run --project src/Coordraw.Cli/Coordraw.Cli.csproj -- compile examples/demo-japanese.crd -o examples/demo-japanese.json
scripts.compile:simple: dotnet run --project src/Coordraw.Cli/Coordraw.Cli.csproj -- compile examples/simple.crd -o examples/simple.json
scripts.render:demo: dotnet run --project src/Coordraw.Cli/Coordraw.Cli.csproj -- render examples/demo-japanese.crd -o examples/demo-japanese.png --fonts examples/fonts.json
scripts.render:simple: dotnet run --project src/Coordraw.Cli/Coordraw.Cli.csproj -- render examples/simple.crd -o examples/simple.png
scripts.test: echo 'Run tests with: dotnet test or msbuild + vstest.console.exe'
